integrity: The proof independently enumerates all polygonal edge-pair solutions after a dihedral reduction and obtains three exact nondegenerate branches plus their exchanges. Exact algebraic branch formulas bound both defining factors and an explicit endpoint pair attains equality in both. The bundled branch-replay checker replays the finite exhaustive branch calculation. No independent audit or independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The exact formula and simultaneous two-factor envelope are proved only for the regular hexadecagonal plane. No all-regular-polygon formula or complete equality-orbit classification is claimed.
title: Exact \(T_G\) constant of the regular hexadecagonal Banach plane
